name: Alma Media Oyj
summary: Alma Media Oyj, a media company, engages in digital services and journalistic media content in Finland, Sweden, Baltics, Croatia, Slovakia, and the Czech Republic. It operates through Alma Career, Alma Marketplaces, and Alma News Media segments. The company offers recruitment-related services through Jobs.cz, Prace.cz, CV-Online, Profesia.sk, MojPosao. net, MojPosao.ba, and Jobly, as well as Seduo online training service and Prace za rohem; and provision of job advertising-related technology, and digital staffing services and training.
